requirements.statement: Pupil arrival must use the south pedestrian interface and must not cross the service route in the working open-site geometry; an equivalent accessible primary horizontal route must remain reserved while grade/profile authority is open.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Current pupil-arrival carrier remains geometrically separate from the service carrier at the present working-site ceiling, while accessibility grade/profile remains explicitly open rather than asserted.
requirements.change_authority_ref: KH-LY46 R5 architecture stage closure / independent successor review
reopen_triggers: Change to site interface, pupil route, service route, grade/profile authority, accessibility basis or permission topology.

requirements.statement: Delivery/catering service must use the east service interface and reach receiving without front-door dependence or geometric crossing with the pupil-arrival centerline; detailed staff/service access requirements remain open.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Current geometry demonstrates east service connection to receiving/service carriers without front-door dependency and without contradicting the pupil-arrival separation rule; specialist service/MEP requirements remain open.
requirements.change_authority_ref: KH-LY46 R5 architecture stage closure / independent successor review
reopen_triggers: Change to service entry, kitchen/receiving location, pupil-arrival geometry, permission topology or MEP/service specialist requirement.

requirements.statement: Alert-to-protected transition must reserve distributed protected-transition interfaces within each occupied territory without depending on public/community site entry; vertical profile and protected-space design remain open.
requirements.owner_ref: Prime Architecture / bounded protected-interface planning owner
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Protected-transition interfaces are present as architectural reserves in each occupied territory, with no claim that class, capacity, exact location, vertical route, MEP or statutory civil-protection criteria are closed.
requirements.verification_owner_ref: Independent Architecture reviewer + future civil-protection specialist
requirements.change_authority_ref: KH-LY46 R5 architecture + civil-protection specialist authority when bound
reopen_triggers: Change to occupied territories, protected-transition locations, civil-protection class/capacity, vertical circulation, structure or MEP.

requirements.statement: Structure, geotechnical and foundation design basis must be established before structure-dependent R5 geometry can be treated as professionally closed rather than a reversible architectural interface assumption.
requirements.owner_ref: Structural Engineering specialist owner / currently unbound
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A current professional structural basis, analysis/checking evidence and architecture↔structure interface readback exist at the required claim ceiling.
requirements.change_authority_ref: Current Structural Engineering process + project specialist authority
reopen_triggers: Any change to retained/new structural system, core geometry, loads, geotechnical/foundation basis or existing-condition evidence.

requirements.statement: MEP capacities and routes must be professionally established before service/core/riser-dependent R5 geometry can be treated as MEP-coordinated or professionally closed.
requirements.owner_ref: Building Services / MEP specialist owner / currently unbound
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Current system basis, capacity/route design and architecture↔MEP interface readback exist at the required claim ceiling.
requirements.verification_owner_ref: Independent MEP professional reviewer / currently unbound
requirements.change_authority_ref: Current Building Services / MEP process + project specialist authority
reopen_triggers: Any change to service/kitchen use, plant/service zones, core/riser geometry, utilities, system capacities or routes.

requirements.statement: Fire strategy, egress and accessibility compliance must remain open until the relevant specialist/statutory basis and evidence are established; architectural planning intent must not be relabeled as compliance.
requirements.owner_ref: Architecture interface owner + fire/accessibility specialist authority / specialist authority currently open
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Fire/egress and accessibility claims are supported by the appropriate specialist/statutory evidence; until then the project explicitly remains at planning-intent/interface ceiling.
requirements.change_authority_ref: Project fire/accessibility specialist and statutory authority when bound
reopen_triggers: Any change to occupancy, door/core/stair/lift geometry, route topology, protected transitions, floor levels or applicable code basis.
